title: An old Product Type link opens Sales By Representative with all types
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Scenario: You bookmarked Sales By Representative narrowed by Product Type before the release, and open the bookmark after it.
  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Before the release was installed, you bookmarked a link to Sales By Representative that narrowed it by Product Type.
  • Starting screen: the release is installed and the bookmark is ready in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps: 1. Open the link bookmarked before the release.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the report opens with every Sales Type selected ("Sales Type: All").

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11272 (Story 8, Filter both sales reports by Sales Type)

  • Release day: “A saved link that narrowed Sales By Representative by Product Type opens with every Sales Type selected.”
  • S8-R3: “With all three selected the filter reads "Sales Type: All". With none it reads "Sales Type: None". Otherwise it reads the selected names in option order, for example "Sales Type: Labor, Parts".”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
